purpose: Focused additive Cathedral showcase questions; research scope is explicit.

questions.query: How does Cathedral Megaframe coordinate four nested scales in one classic native Gentek?
facts: A four-bay by three-storey supercell anchors the primary frame, side arcades, galleries and clerestory details.
It is schema-4 cathedral_megaframe v1, a Draft stacked sampler, not self-assembly.

questions.query: What do room size, floor height, wall thickness, automatic windows and doors change in Cathedral Megaframe?
facts: Room size sets nested horizontal spacing; floor height sets vertical rhythms; wall thickness changes structural mass.
Windows off substitutes shell for glazing without changing occupied geometry; portals affect lower buttresses.
Bay and floor must each be at least six wall thicknesses plus sixteen cells.

questions.query: Why are Cathedral Megaframe seed choices independent of chunk order and signed world origin?
facts: Fixed supercell and shared-boundary hash keys choose bounded architectural variants.
Signed floor division and positive modulo produce local coordinates without mutable state.

questions.query: Are the Cathedral showcase PNGs native material output and how is their source identity verified?
facts: CyberWorldGenerator material IDs use the existing preview LUT; each map retains material bytes, recipe, project and receipts.
A before-build input ledger and after-execution comparison bind the executed extension and PNGs.
The parent 72 classics and Viaduct hashes remain regression controls.
